title: EdgeTX Package State
description: JSON Schema for one PKG/packages/<package-key>.yml file, the record of one installed package on an SD card (edgetx_format_version 1.x). See docs/State.md for the normative specification. An absent optional field and an explicit null are equivalent. This file also defines $defs/operationMarker, the format of PKG/.operation.
$comment: additionalProperties is true throughout so that unknown keys are ignored rather than rejected. A MINOR format bump may add optional fields, and older tooling must still read a package state file. See docs/Manifest.md, 'edgetx_format_version'.

edgetx_format_version.description: Revision of the EdgeTX package file format this package state file conforms to. Same field and numbering as a manifest. Absent means "1.0". See docs/Manifest.md#edgetx_format_version.

packageId.description: Canonical package identifier, same form as a manifest's package.id. See docs/Manifest.md#package-id.

versionRequirement.description: Semver range the dependency's package.version must satisfy. Absent or '*' means any version. One comparator ('1.2.3', '=1.2.3', '^1.2.0', '~1.2.0', '>=1.2.0', '<2.0.0'), or two space-separated comparators forming a bounded range ('>=1.2.0 <2.0.0'). See docs/Manifest.md#version-ranges.

gitRefName.description: Git tag or branch name with git refname restrictions and the extra safety rule that it must not begin with '-'.

localAbsolutePath.description: Absolute path on the host filesystem. Accepts POSIX absolute paths including '/', and Windows drive-absolute paths such as 'C:/repo' or 'C:\repo'.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with the Z UTC designator. Offset forms such as +00:00 are not used, so the value sorts and compares textually. See docs/State.md.

version.description: package.version at install, or null when the manifest declared none.

reason.description: Whether the user asked for this package, or it came in as a dependency.

variant.description: The exact variants[].path string from the base manifest, or null.

name.description: Display name. Presentation only; never a key.

requires.description: Snapshot of the manifest's requires list, [] when the manifest declares none. Required: orphan cleanup and the check that a removal leaves nothing unsatisfied are not computable offline without it. See docs/State.md#dependency-snapshot.

installedPackage.$comment: The identity of an installed package is the `(id, commit)` pair, with `commit` taken from `source.commit` when present. JSON Schema validates one package-state file at a time, so cross-file uniqueness is checked when tooling loads PKG/packages/. See docs/State.md#validation-summary.

ref.description: The tag or branch name installed from. Constrained because this value is read off a removable card and handed to a fetch: no control characters, no leading '-' that a command line would read as an option, and only characters a git refname may contain. Null for channel commit and local. See docs/State.md#source.

commit.description: The full resolved commit object id in lowercase hex: 40 characters for SHA-1, 64 for a SHA-256 repository. Abbreviated ids MUST NOT be recorded. Null only for channel: local. See docs/State.md#source.

origin.description: Set when fetched from somewhere other than the declared id — a fork.

path.description: Absolute path on the host filesystem, for channel: local. This is the one path in state that is not an SD card path, so the SD path rules do not apply — but it must still carry no control characters. Accepts POSIX absolute paths including `/`, and Windows drive-absolute paths such as `C:/repo` or `C:\repo`. See docs/State.md#source.

manifest_path.description: Repo-relative path of the manifest that was loaded. When a variant was selected this is the base manifest. See docs/State.md#source.

allOf.$comment: A local install records where it came from on the host, and must not claim a git ref or commit.
A commit install records the resolved commit only, not a branch/tag ref or local host path.
A tag or branch install records the chosen ref and resolved commit, and must not claim a local host path.

source.description: Where the package came from, and which commit is installed. See docs/State.md#source.

requirement.description: One entry of the package's requires list, snapshotted at install. See docs/State.md#dependency-snapshot.

operationMarker.description: PKG/.operation — written before an operation modifies the card, deleted after the final state write. Its presence means the last operation did not finish. See docs/State.md#durability.

package_id.description: The package the USER asked for. One marker covers the whole request, not one per dependency.

variantPath.description: The exact variants[].path string from the base manifest. Must stay inside the manifest directory. See docs/State.md#variant.

requiredTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with the Z UTC designator. Not nullable.

repoRelativePath.description: A relative path inside the package repository, never an install destination. Same rules as safeRelativePath except that 'PKG/' is not reserved, since nothing here is written to the SD card. See docs/Manifest.md#path-rules.
